scenarios.name: other-knights-get-plus-one-and-indestructible
scenarios.why: Other Knight creatures you control get +1/+1 and have indestructible: Black Knight (2/2 with first strike) is 3/3 and survives Lightning Bolt's 3 damage with 3 marked damage; the Exemplar itself is not affected (still 2/2).

scenarios.name: without-the-exemplar-the-bolt-kills
scenarios.why: Control: with no Knight Exemplar in play, Black Knight is a plain 2/2 with no indestructible, so the same Lightning Bolt destroys it.
